disposition_reason: The row clearly defines ConnectX/BlueField thermal qualification through NVQual Test #37. Target sensor map, environment, workload intensity, cadence and signed warning/throttle/hard-stop limits are Project Configuration. A complete interlocked 120-minute time-series testcase can be reviewed now; ED-15 keeps PASS impossible until limits are bound.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2142, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2143 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00020-V002 / d932af60f9cd7b95 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.

test_case.test_name: Controlled 120-minute ConnectX/BlueField NVQual Test #37 thermal soak
test_case.purpose: Apply the approved Test #37 load to the exact NIC/DPU for 120 minutes and prove heat-up, steady state, throttling and cooldown remain within signed limits without link/device errors, unsafe platform effects, hang or reboot.
required_package: Licensed pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #37 and compatible ConnectX/BlueField firmware/driver
Signed NIC/DPU serial/port/BDF and calibrated canonical sensor/units map
Approved traffic/load phases, intensity, peer, 120-minute duration and sample cadence
Signed ambient/inlet, airflow/fan/power envelope and warning/throttle/hard-stop/cooldown limits
Dedicated SUT, independent BMC/host/device telemetry, emergency stop and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration and thermal limits are signed. Verify target sensors, ambient/inlet and redundant airflow; preserve/hash idle baselines and keep all protections enabled. Run only the pinned Test #37 load for 120 minutes while collecting synchronized device/BMC temperature, fan, power, throttle, traffic, link and error time series through cooldown. Stop at the first sensor/cooling/limit/health anomaly; do not continue or retry.
test_case.expected_result: The exact target completes all approved load phases and 120-minute interval; every calibrated sensor remains within warning/throttle/hard-stop policy, no unexpected throttling or link/device/platform error occurs, and the system cools to the signed stable endpoint without hang or reboot.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without target/sensor provenance, controlled environment/load and signed thermal/cooldown limits. PASS requires the complete accepted heat-up, steady-state and cooldown series plus clean health evidence. FAIL on missing/disagreeing sensor, airflow/fan failure, limit breach, unexpected throttle, link/error burst, thermal/power fault, hang/reboot or failed cooldown/recovery. Missing inputs/artifacts are BLOCKED; a point sample or module pass is insufficient.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until target/sensors, environment, load, cadence, warning/throttle/hard-stop and cooldown/recovery contract are signed.
Verify redundant airflow and independent telemetry before load; thermal protections must remain enabled.
Use a dedicated SUT with operator-controlled emergency stop and stable power/cooling.
Stop immediately and never automatically retry after any sensor, cooling, thermal or platform fault.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #37 module/configuration and authorization
Target serial/port/BDF, canonical sensor names/units/calibration and ambient/inlet/airflow/fan baseline
Signed load phases/intensity/duration/cadence and warning/throttle/hard-stop/cooldown matrix
Complete synchronized heat-up/steady-state/cooldown temperature, fan, power, throttle, traffic, link and error series
Raw NVQual output plus NIC/kernel/BMC/SEL and thermal-protection state
First-fault abort/recovery or verified stable final idle state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On sensor loss/disagreement, airflow/fan failure, hard-limit breach, unexpected throttle, link/device/platform fault or evidence gap, terminate load through the approved stop path and preserve first-fault data. Maintain cooling and protections, follow signed cooldown/isolation, do not rerun automatically, and quarantine if sensors or stable idle state do not recover.
